metric_justification: In industrial predictive maintenance (MachineMitra), the operational objective is zero unplanned machine downtime. Missing a machine failure (False Negative) leads to catastrophic line stoppage, costly emergency repairs, and safety risks. Conversely, a false alarm (False Positive) only triggers a preventive inspection. Because the failure class is extremely rare (3.39% in the incoming batch), standard Accuracy is misleading—a naive classifier predicting 'Normal' on all cycles yields 96.61% accuracy while catching 0% of failures. Therefore, Recall (Sensitivity) is selected as the primary safety metric to maximize failure capture, paired with F1-Score to ensure that Precision is not sacrificed, and PR-AUC to assess threshold-independent performance on highly imbalanced data.
decision_summary: Candidate model outperformed Champion. Recall improved by +15.04%, F1-score improved by +11.29%, preventing 51 missed breakdowns.
